<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
<jats:p>By careful analysis of the embedding of a simplicial set into its image under Kan’s <jats:inline-formula><jats:alternatives><jats:tex-math>$$\mathop {\mathop {\mathsf {Ex}}^\infty }$$</jats:tex-math><mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mml:msup><mml:mrow><mml:mi>Ex</mml:mi></mml:mrow><mml:mi>∞</mml:mi></mml:msup></mml:math></jats:alternatives></jats:inline-formula> functor we obtain a new and combinatorial proof that it is a weak homotopy equivalence. Moreover, we obtain a presentation of it as a <jats:italic>strong anodyne extension</jats:italic>. From this description we can quickly deduce some basic facts about <jats:inline-formula><jats:alternatives><jats:tex-math>$$\mathop {\mathop {\mathsf {Ex}}^\infty }$$</jats:tex-math><mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mml:msup><mml:mrow><mml:mi>Ex</mml:mi></mml:mrow><mml:mi>∞</mml:mi></mml:msup></mml:math></jats:alternatives></jats:inline-formula> and hence provide a new construction of the Kan–Quillen model structure on simplicial sets, one which avoids the use of topological spaces or minimal fibrations.</jats:p>
title: Another approach to the Kan–Quillen model structure
